title: Nautical Dunes | KEY.co
description_expanded: Welcome to this exquisite five-bedroom vacation home located in Santa Rosa Beach, where the perfect beach getaway awaits you! Nestled within an enclosed backyard, this property offers a tranquil oasis complete with an inviting in-ground outdoor pool, a shaded patio boasting an outdoor dining area, and a convenient propane grill for delightful warm-weather barbecues. The prime location of this home is unparalleled, providing easy access to the nearby beach and a plethora of renowned 30-A restaurants. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a captivating coastal ambiance that permeates throughout the entire residence. The nautical decor, combined with pristine tiled floors, creates an inviting atmosphere that promises relaxation. To your right, the first dining area beckons, offering ample seating for up to seven guests. On the opposite side, an inviting family room with two comfortable sofas awaits, providing an ideal spot to unwind after a day of exploration.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Two Single Over Double Bunks

Features: Indoor Dryer Washer Air conditioning Internet
The use of charcoal grills is not allowed.
